description: This file contains setup and initialization scripts for manufacturing data within an ERPNext system. It defines functions to set up workstations, items, assets, product bundles, item prices, and display settings, primarily used to initialize or populate demo data related to manufacturing processes.

methods.name: setup_data()
methods.description: Main function to orchestrate the setup of demo manufacturing data, including locations, asset categories, items, workstations, assets, BOMs, item prices, and website display settings.

methods.name: setup_workstation()
methods.description: Creates multiple predefined workstation documents with randomized rates and fixed working hours.

methods.name: show_item_groups_in_website()
methods.description: Sets the 'show_in_website' property for the 'Products' item group to make it visible on the website.

methods.name: setup_asset()
methods.description: Loads asset data from a JSON file and creates Asset documents, setting purchase dates randomly in the past and scheduling depreciation.

methods.name: setup_item()
methods.description: Loads item data from a JSON file and creates Item documents, associating default warehouse details with company data.

methods.name: setup_product_bundle()
methods.description: Creates a product bundle with associated items.

methods.name: setup_item_price()
methods.description: Deletes existing item prices and sets standard buying and selling prices for multiple items.
